mechanism: The engine manages JavaScript object storage. Tracing starts from roots and follows references; unreachable objects become eligible for reclamation.
why: Reachability lets the runtime reclaim unused object storage without programmer-issued free calls.
useWhen: Ordinary JavaScript objects. Release references when finished; GC cannot reclaim objects still retained by the program.
price: Collection consumes execution time and memory. Losing the last reference does not guarantee immediate reclamation.
syntaxExample:
let item = { value: 1 }; let retained = item; item = null; // retained still refers to the object
retained = null; // eligible if nothing else retains it; no collection deadline

empowered_by.how: Follows object references from roots to identify reachable storage.
